topNews.text: Sumatran Tiger Cubs Born in the UK Is Huge Win–with Only 400 Left in Wild
topNews.excerpt: In a valuable milestone for the conservation of the Sumatran tiger subspecies, 3 cubs born to a UK zoo have grown old enough to venture out from the maternity den into the enclosure. topNews.text: No Outstanding Coal Mining Applications Left in the UK After Council Refusal in Carmarthenshire
topNews.excerpt: After a Welsh council rejected plans to dig for 85,000 tons of coal, the UK has no outstanding proposals for coal mining anywhere in the country.
